note: Triennial rural district council election. Voting in Tyrone took place on Wednesday 31 May 1933; no nomination was received for Clady (Strabane Chronicle, 22 April 1933, p. 1). Mr. Joseph Mills, the retiring member (returned for Clady in 1930), was deemed elected (Strabane Chronicle, 15 July 1933, p. 1), but he wrote declining to accept the councillorship (he had not sought nomination and was done with the council); the Council declared a vacancy in the division on 13 June 1933 (Strabane Chronicle, 17 June 1933, p. 1), and when he adhered to his decision in July 1933 Miss Mayne gave notice to move the co-option of a member in his room. The co-option, which is not an election, was not found. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
